review.verdict: One Rebirth, 220 Faerie Fires, and 11th of 12 healers twice
review.summary: The Rebirth on Eduard after Dark Glare on C'Thun was the right call. Then the healing: 11th of 12 on Skeram and Viscidus, 10th on Sartura. You found time for 220 Faerie Fires, which is a lot of global cooldowns for someone whose job was the green bars. Third on Huhuran and 25 dispels, 18 of them Poison Bolt Volleys, so the poison button worked. Stood in a Blizzard and an exploding bug on the Twins.
